400400101.text: Gather round, gather round! If you're passing by, don't pass this up: Introducing the amazing Shadow Lantern!

400400102.text: "Shadow Lantern"? Ooh, Paimon's never heard of this one before!

400400103.text: You two look like you're out to have some fun! Care to check out the Shadow Lantern? My latest invention, made to amaze and amuse!

400400104.text: It's very simple — all you have to do is rotate the objects inside the Shadow Lantern, get all the shadows to merge in a certain way, and the most incredible images will be revealed before your very eyes.

400400106.text: Intrigued? You should try it out for yourself! It's set up right here — please, peruse and use at your leisure.

400400107.text: I hope the Shadow Lantern shows you something truly spectacular.

400400108.text: Sounds pretty cool! Let's give it a whirl.
